commit.message:
Improve docker socket volume exposed rule for docker-compose files (#2079)

* Improve docker socket volume exposed rule for docker-compose files

Previously, the rule would not match unless the offending volume was the
last volume in the list of volumes. Now, it will match.

Also, on most modern Linux systems, /var/run is just a symlink to /run.
Users could therefore have avoided detection by just using
/run/docker.sock instead of /var/run/docker.sock. This loophole is now
hopefully closed.

* Detect cases where custom volume paths inside container are omitted

It isn't compulsory to specify a custom path inside the container if
both paths match. Previously, users could have avoided detection by
simply ommitting the custom path inside the container.

* Detect usages of long-form volume syntax in docker-compose files

The docker-compose file format supports several different approachs for
specifying volumes. Previously, users could have avoided detection by
using the long-form syntax.

* Add some more regression tests for docker-compose socket volume rule
